integrity: The sharp upper bound is analytic; attainment and uniqueness are proved by an exact algebraic factorization and contact equations. The checker is corroborative and does not replace the proof.
limitations: Only the continuous real-even support \(\{1,4,5\}\) is treated.
No claim is made for discretized grids or for arbitrary two-element higher-frequency sets.
An older equivalent statement under substantially different notation remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact Carathéodory–Fejér constant for \(H=\{4,5\}\)
